'''Ardran''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Adran had an [[Ardran's apprentice|apprentice]] who was disliked by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Thrain]] for their privileged attitude, which meant that the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] would most likely never become a full [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].
